# sigma_account_type_permissions (Data Source)

Lists feature permissions for a Sigma account type. The API returns a JSON array rather than a paginated envelope. Results preserve Sigma API order; key collections by returned IDs rather than positional indices. Pagination cursors and page sizes are not exposed; this data source retrieves every page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_account_type_permissions" "example" {
  account_type_id = "account-type-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_type_id` (String) Account type ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.
- `permissions` (Attributes List) Permissions in API order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Human-readable description (`description`).
- `permission` (String) Permission name (`permission`).
